name: Ada Brightshield
title: The Gatekeeper

ability.name: Sun Guard
ability.tooltip_en: Gains a shield for three seconds.
ability.tooltip_id: Memberikan perisai sementara kepada diri sendiri.

art.silhouette: A broad inverted-triangle shoulder line over a compact waist, anchored by an oversized rounded kite shield on the left. The shield rises to eyebrow height when guarding, but stays below her eyes at rest.
art.face: Warm brown skin, square brows, dark eyes and a short black braid tucked behind the neck. Her calm, alert expression is readable without exaggerated facial animation.
art.costume: An ivory quilted coat sits under simplified steel breast and shoulder plates. A split navy tabard ends above the knees, leaving the leg silhouettes clear. Heavy boots and broad bracers make her planted stance apparent.
art.palette: Navy #25466B; ivory #E9E2CD; brushed steel #9EAAB5; restrained gold #C7A25B. Gold covers only the shield crest and two fasteners.
art.equipment: Left-hand kite shield with a raised rising-sun disk; short, broad fantasy sword in the right hand. Build the emblem as shallow geometry with a baked bevel, not dense engraving.
art.signature: The high curved shield, squared shoulder line, and single sun disk must survive a 96-pixel hero render.
art.materials: Use a shared armor master, a cloth instance and a small emissive crest mask. Keep roughness separation between plate, fabric and the leather shield grip; no mirror-polished surfaces.
art.back: A navy crossed strap carries a plain bedroll clasp; the braid sits clear of the shoulder plates. No long cape hides the back silhouette.
art.animation: Idle with weight on the rear foot and shield angled outward. Walk with measured short steps. Basic attacks use one readable right-hand sweep. The active lifts the shield before the crest lights; return to guard without whole-body root motion.
art.vfx: A thin warm-gold shell follows the shield silhouette and a brief low-opacity arc wraps the torso. Do not use a solid sphere that obscures nearby heroes.
art.audio: A firm boot placement, restrained metal knock, and short rounded shield chime. Avoid a booming impact on every basic attack.
art.risk: Shield/forearm intersections during attack recovery are the main deformation risk. Test full left-arm elevation and adjacent-hero visibility.

biography: Ada kept Brighthavenâ€™s river gate open during the evacuation of a flooded caravan road. She joins the Compact trials to teach young captains that protecting an ally is a deliberate choice, not a consolation role. Mira maintained the roadside aid station beside her gate, and the two trust each other without always agreeing on when to advance.

tactics.placement: Front row, one cell ahead of a damage dealer; center-left leaves room for her shield silhouette.
tactics.partner: Mira Dawnwell extends Adaâ€™s time on the frontline; Rowan Emberwick uses the space she buys.
tactics.counter: Zura Stormcall applies magic damage against Adaâ€™s lower resistance; sustained focused attacks can exhaust the shield before its duration ends.
tactics.weakness: Low offensive output and a self-only shield: she cannot rescue a distant backline unit.
tactics.contrast: Unlike Borin, Ada prevents damage to herself instead of interrupting surrounding enemies.
tactics.test: Check that a shielded Ada still takes overflow damage correctly and cannot refresh a stronger shield with a weaker cast.
